name: DC-to-DC converter
summary: A DC/DC converter changes a documented DC input into another DC output.
description: A DC/DC converter changes a documented DC input into another DC output. Isolation, regulation and polarity depend on the selected model and must not be inferred from the conversion label.
readingNotes: Check whether input and output commons are connected internally.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A DC/DC conversion function does not automatically provide galvanic isolation.
